messages:
Jules: FYI Stratus support reported inconsistent date formatting after we merged their LoRA into helix-core-3 and applied int4 quant. Can we take a quick look?
Nina: Which date cases? iso vs human? examples plz.
Stratus-PS: (customer) We saw '2025-11-07' become '11/7/25' or sometimes 'Nov 7th', breaking our downstream extractor. Appeared after last night's deploy.
Ravi: Possible calibration/softmax rounding from int4 or tokenizer token split differences. Do you have the merge command?
Jules: Merge command used by their eng:```bash
redwood merge --base helix-core-3 --adapter stratus-lora-v2 \
  --out stratus-merged-hc3 --quant int4 --merge-tokenizer keep
```
Nina: Interesting they used `--merge-tokenizer keep`. So tokenizer likely same. That points more to quantization clipping of decimal tokens or changed BPE segmentation at boundaries.
Ravi: I'll run a focused pack `stratus-date-quickcheck-20` (20 prompts: ISO, slashed, verbose, timezones) in three configs: fp16, int4-static, int4-calibrated.
Jules: Thanks. ops-bot: start job jb_str_110 (dev-gpu).
ops-bot: job jb_str_110 queued -> running. ETA 8m.
Stratus-PS: happy to run a mirror test once you confirm config that keeps date canonical.
Nina: Quick results (sanity):
- fp16 baseline: canonical-date exact-match 0.94
- int4-static (default): 0.67 
- int4-calibrated (per-token range): 0.88
So uncalibrated int4 often collapses punctuation tokens and prefers shorter renderings.
Ravi: root cause: our int4 static quant table pushes logits for punctuation chars down; calibration (per-token scale) recovers most cases.
Jules: Action items: 1) re-merge for Stratus with int4-calibrated profile; 2) add a quick-date-mini-check (5 examples) to merge CI that blocks if canonical-date drop > 0.06; 3) doc note on int4 caveats for punctuation-heavy tasks.
Stratus-PS: that sounds great. please ping when re-merge is up and we'll smoke on staging.
Nina: I'll add a warning in merge tool: "int4-static may change punctuation-heavy outputs; consider --calibrate-int4" and expose `--calibrate-int4` as opt-in for now.
Jules: i'll coordinate the re-merge and paste job link. thanks team :rocket:
